title: Swift test baselineCreateRefusesToOverwriteAndUpdateDoes is flaky on CI
notes: 2026-11-23: failed once on main at 01887cb5 (CheckCommandTests.swift:50-52, all three runBinary statuses wrong), passed on the re-run and on the previous commit with identical Swift sources and Package.resolved.
